description: Varstatt Discovery is a suite of free, AI-powered technical discovery tools designed to help founders bridge the gap between a product vision and a developer-ready specification. By translating high-level ideas into structured documentation, the platform ensures that project requirements include the technical depth developers need, such as acceptance criteria and edge cases. The tools are built to prevent scope creep, which is often the primary reason MVPs fail to launch on time. Streamlined Pro
